Testimonials

BOOK REVIEWS

Read how The Future of Healthcare has resonated with readers navigating illness, aging, and uncertainty. These reflections come from individuals who found clarity, reassurance, and renewed confidence through Neal Pearcy’s insight.

[/vc_column_text][carousel script=”owl_carousel” desktop_cols=”3″ desktop_small_cols=”3″ tablet_cols=”2″ mobile_cols=”1″ column_padding=”20px”][item id=”1772196973102-4″ tab_id=”1772196973103-9″ title=”Item”][vc_column_text el_class=”testi-text”]“This book explained what I’ve been feeling for years about healthcare—but couldn’t put into words.”

 B. Dale
Founder & CEO

[/vc_column_text][/item][item id=”1772196973151-10″ tab_id=”1772196973151-10″ title=”Item”][vc_column_text el_class=”testi-text”]“Clear, honest, and deeply reassuring. It helped me understand my options without fear.”

Alexender
Manager

[/vc_column_text][/item][item id=”1772196973176-2″ tab_id=”1772196973177-4″ title=”Item”][vc_column_text el_class=”testi-text”]“A rare book that respects doctors while truly advocating for patients.”

J. Blume
Customer

[/vc_column_text][/item][item id=”1772196973207-7″ tab_id=”1772196973207-6″ title=”Item”][vc_column_text el_class=”testi-text”]”I bought Staying Alive for my father after his diagnosis. He finished it in two days and called me on the third. That call told me everything I needed to know about this book.”

Patricia M., Ohio

[/vc_column_text][/item][item id=”1772196973231-3″ tab_id=”1772196973232-6″ title=”Item”][vc_column_text el_class=”testi-text”]”The Future of Healthcare should be handed out at every hospital discharge. I’ve spent four years trying to explain to my mother why her five specialists never talk to each other. Neal explained it in one chapter.”

Sandra K., Florida

[/vc_column_text][/item][item id=”1772196973265-8″ tab_id=”1772196973265-9″ title=”Item”][vc_column_text el_class=”testi-text”]”I’m a nurse of 22 years and I still learned something. More importantly, I felt something. That doesn’t happen often with health books.”

Renee T., RN, California

[/vc_column_text][/item][item id=”1772196973297-6″ tab_id=”1772196973298-0″ title=”Item”][vc_column_text el_class=”testi-text”]”My husband passed last year after a long illness. I wish I had found Staying Alive sooner. Not just for him. For me.”

Carol B., Pennsylvania

[/vc_column_text][/item][item id=”1772196973323-2″ tab_id=”1772196973323-9″ title=”Item”][vc_column_text el_class=”testi-text”]”I flagged so many pages in The Future of Healthcare that my copy is basically half sticky notes now. This is the conversation we should all be having.”

Theresa N., New York

[/vc_column_text][/item][item id=”1772196973348-4″ tab_id=”1772196973349-2″ title=”Item”][vc_column_text el_class=”testi-text”]”At 79 I didn’t expect a book to change how I think about my own health. This one did. I went to my next doctor’s appointment with a list of questions I never would have thought to ask before.”

Robert A., Arizona

[/vc_column_text][/item][/carousel][/vc_column][/vc_row]
